data.name: Party Executable
data.detailed_description:
Party Executable is a narrative adventure game, discover lost secrets and interact with peculiar characters to learn more about the prison that is Fauxidy Manor.

Features

  • Interactive Dialogue! Interact with the many characters the Manor has to offer! Make dialogue choices to complement them, insult them, gather more information, give characters certain items, and many more possibilities!

  • Collect Stuff! Fauxidy Manor has many free things to steal collect for yourself, you just need to find them! Collect pinatas, crystals, spiders, and more! Each item has unique description which you can find in your codex. Some key items are also very useful in accessing certain parts of the Manor, or perhaps as a gift to certain entities!

  • Buy Stuff! Unfortunately there are things which are not free. They are held in a shop and you will need to collect tokens in order to purchase them. You can find tokens scattered in unusual places or perhaps as rewards for doing certain activities!

  • Read Classified Documents! Along with normal items and tokens, there are also documents which can be picked up and read! They are saved into your Codex so you can read them at any time! The contents can be anything from incidents, to love letters, to number combinations, or even about ████████████!

  • Explore the Manor! There are many places to reach in Fauxidy Manor, and multiple ways to reach them! Take your time and let the atmosphere of the funny oppressive Manor wash over you! Be careful however...

  • Survive. The Manor is rife with threats which threaten to end your life. You can run, you can hide, but combat is never an option. The horrors each have their own reasons for hunting you down, but that will not stop you from reaching your goal and escaping. Also be wise about the choices you make, as certain choices will make Fauxidy Manor more hostile towards you.

data.short_description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intergrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Party Executable contains content that is not suitable for all ages. Depictions of mild gore, infrequent blood, accidental death, and reference to suicide are present.
